segments.text: The transfer student who sits behind the protagonist, she is a bright and cheerful girl who quickly becomes friends with him. Her hobby is gardening. Because her family is super poor, she wears her sister's old school uniform that is way too big for her. She expresses pity for the school's desolate gardening club, and took on the task of taking care of the flowers. Since it's difficult work and very inconvenient for her to do by herself, the protagonist begun helping her. Together, they are determined to revive the gardening club.

She is the reincarnation of Ayana, the older sister of Konomi who is in love with Haruma. At the end of her route, she gets pregnant and gives birth to the protagonist's child. A daughter who she names Haruno (はるの). Her name Ayasaki Nanoka can be rearrange into Sakakino Ayana.
晴真のクラスの転校生で、晴真の後ろ席。
明るくて人懐っこい子犬のような性格で、趣味はガーデニングと、いろいろな要因が重なり、すぐに晴真と意気投合して、友達になる。
彼女いわく「うちは超貧乏」なため、お姉ちゃんのお下がりで、サイズの合わないぶかぶかな制服を着ている。
学校の寂れた花壇を不憫に思い、花壇の手入れをしようと思っていたが、彼女一人では不便な点が多く、困っていたところ、晴真の後押しで、過去に廃部した園芸部を復活させようと決意をする。

The protagonist's neighbor and childhood friend who is one year younger. Their parents wants the two to get married when they grow up, so they been together since they were kids and have had a lot of romantic moments together. But evidently they look more like siblings than lovers. Due to family reasons, she has been living with the protagonist for a very long time, helping him with the flower shop. Capable and reliable girl, she is in charge of the housework and the shop. Despite being such a reliable and cute girl, she likes to joke around and has a childish side.
真の隣の家に住んでいる、一個下の幼なじみ。
晴真とこのみの両親は、とあるきっかけから家族ぐるみの付き合いをしており、二人は物心つく前から一緒に過ごして来た仲で、実の兄妹以上に知れた関係。
家庭の事情により、幼少期の頃から、今でもこのみは、晴真の家で暮らしており、晴真と一緒に「フラワーショップ・はるかぜ（花屋）」の手伝いをしている。
世話焼きでしっかり者なため、晴真の家では母親代わりに家事や店を切り盛りして、真澄（晴真の父親）からも一目置かれている、頼りになる存在なのだが、一方で、実は冗談好きで、子供っぽさが抜けず、晴真と二人きりの時は、エッチな冗談を言って晴真を困らせている。

Third-year student and self-claimed volunteer of the ministry. She worries about the protagonist's hospitalization and often visits him. When the protagonist and Nanoka were seeking the ministry's help in reviving the gardening club, she did everything she could to help. Cheerful and energetic, but also mischievous, she actively helps with the atmosphere in her circles. She doesn't care about who is the senpai or kouhai with her close friends. Because of her parents' work, they are rarely ever home, so she is basically living alone.

入院していた晴真のことを気遣い、同輩の祐希と一緒に、いろいろと世話を焼く。

The protagonist's classmate, she often takes care of him. Like the protagonist, she is also isolated so they are good friends and get along well. She says stuff like how the protagonist is her first friend. Quiet and always looks like she is about to fall asleep, a strange girl that no one knows what she is thinking. Reacts negatively to everything, she is the type of girl that stays on the sidelines.

水着等のグラビアで肌を露出させたり、キスシーンなどの恋愛行為がＮＧで、今に至るまでかなりの苦労があったが、逆に今ではその清純さがファンに受けている。

The older sister of Konomi who was in love with the protagonist one year before the main story of this game happens. She dies in a fire which nearly causes a mental break for the protagonist. She later returns as Ayasaki Nanoka, in order to bring happiness to protagonist. Her name Sakakino Ayana can be rearrange into Ayasaki Nanoka.
Nanoka and Haruma's daughter. She's also the incarnation of Nanoka.
